sentiment.rationale: Full-year EPS guidance was reduced from $14.64 in 2024 to a range of $12.92-$13.02, and Q4 revenue guidance is negative 3% to negative 1% versus last year. Management explicitly stated that 'the negatives will outweigh the positives' for 2026 operating margin, citing a full year of increased tariffs and removal of de minimis provision. The CEO transition and acknowledged post-Thanksgiving demand pullback further reinforce a bearish forward outlook.

summary.revenue: $2.6 billion, up 7% on both reported and constant currency basis.
summary.eps: $2.59 per diluted share, down from $2.87 in Q3 2024.
summary.guidance: Full-year revenue expected $10.96 billion to $11.05 billion (4% growth); full-year diluted EPS expected $12.92 to $13.02, down from $14.64 in 2024; Q4 revenue expected $3.5 billion to $3.59 billion (negative 3% to negative 1% vs last year).
summary.margin: Q3 gross margin 55.6%, down 290 bps; full-year gross margin expected to decrease ~270 bps; Q4 gross margin expected to decrease ~580 bps.
key_risks: Tariffs and removal of de minimis provision causing significant margin pressure (410 bps in Q4).
U.S. comparable sales declined 5% in Q3; Americas revenue down 2%.
Post-Thanksgiving demand pullback reflected in Q4 guidance.
CEO transition with Calvin McDonald stepping down on January 31.
Markdowns increased 90 bps in Q3, expected to increase 100 bps in Q4.
Inventory increased 11% to $2 billion, outpacing sales growth.
Full-year operating margin expected to decrease ~390 bps.
Management stated 'negatives will outweigh the positives' for 2026 operating margin.
key_opportunities: China Mainland revenue up 46% (47% constant currency), now expected at or above high end of 20%-25% annual growth.
Rest of World revenue up 19% constant currency.
Digital revenue up 13%, constituting 42% of total revenue.
New style penetration targeted at 35% for spring 2026.
Chase capabilities enabling replenishment in 6-8 weeks for strong performers.
Strong balance sheet with $1 billion cash and no debt.
Share repurchase authorization of $1.6 billion remaining.

management_tone.label: cautious
management_tone.justification: Management repeatedly hedged forward language, stating 'it is fair to assume that the negatives will outweigh the positives' for 2026 and acknowledging 'some pullback in demand post Thanksgiving' which was reflected in guidance.
